title: Geologic Map of the Johnston Quadrangle, Edgefield and Saluda Counties, South Carolina
citation: Morrow, R.H., IV, 2019, Geologic Map of the Johnston Quadrangle, Edgefield and Saluda Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report 238, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; the description text is clean. Unit symbols are read from the parentheses in each description; the boxed symbols beside them are garbled and ignored. 'QI' read as Ql is flagged inferred and unclear. The diabase symbol is garbled and not recorded. Members of the Emory and Persimmon Fork Formations are recorded as separate units. Legend-only features (strike-dip symbol types, the Delmar overturned anticlinorium and overturned syncline symbols, contact line type, auger-hole symbol) not recorded. Hibbard and others 2013 (North Carolina) skipped. The sheet says its products are provided 'as is' without warranty.
SUBSURFACE: none usable. No cross section, structure-contour map, or logs on the sheet; power-auger holes are plotted only by SCGS field number. Topographic range 375-636 ft. Datum: horizontal 1983 North American Datum; contour interval 10 feet; vertical datum not stated.
